note: Battery cost index series used to normalize comparables to 2026 (research pass 2 Oct 2026; values from search-index excerpts of the publishers' releases, no interpolation by the researcher). adjust_model.py interpolates linearly between published points and holds series flat outside their span. Pack and turnkey are real dollars of each survey year; EIA and LBNL nominal; NREL as published; LCOS is $/MWh (a levelized, not capital, metric). Revised 5 Oct 2026: the installed series carries every EIA year 2015-2022 from the 2024 figure data file; adjust_model.py now holds physical quantities fixed (a fixed-weight composite index anchored on 2024 shares) instead of holding today's dollar shares fixed, so the implied battery share of an older project rises with the battery prices of its year.

construction_index.label: Handy-Whitman North Atlantic, total steam production plant (July index, 1973 = 100), as posted by PJM
construction_index.conf: Medium (2015-2018 seen in excerpt; later years from search summary of the same posting); production-plant line, not distribution plant

installed.label: Installed all-in (EIA-860 2015-22, LBNL 2024)

installed.conf: High 2015-2022 (EIA figure data, official); High 2024 (LBNL) but a different sample; 2023 interpolated; held flat after 2024
